findings.label: Acceptance test scenarios use placeholders for database-dependent assertions
findings.description: Scenario A/B leave real message storage and audit verification to comments. Run integration tests after Docker Compose startup to verify these scenarios work end-to-end.

findings.label: Audit chain verification is mocked in acceptance tests
findings.description: The test sets `audit_breaks = []` instead of calling `verify_audit_chain(session, tenant_id)`. This will need a database connection and is correctly deferred to integration tier.

findings.label: Migrations expect PostgreSQL-specific features
findings.description: The baseline schema uses `pgvector` and `pgcrypto` extensions and the audit trigger uses PL/pgSQL. Ensure PostgreSQL 14+ is available; other database engines are not supported.
